Author: Ali Rahman <ali@example.com>

diff --git a/csvimport/reader.py b/csvimport/reader.py
index 96ab4c3..f533556 100644
--- a/csvimport/reader.py
+++ b/csvimport/reader.py
@@ -2,9 +2,16 @@
 
 
 def rows(text):
-    """Rows of fields. Fields may be double-quoted; quotes inside are doubled."""
-    out = []
+    """Rows of fields. Fields may be double-quoted; quotes inside are doubled,
+    and a quoted field may span lines (#42)."""
+    out, pending = [], None
     for line in text.split("\n"):
+        if pending is not None:
+            line = pending + "\n" + line
+            pending = None
+        if line.count('"') % 2:
+            pending = line
+            continue
         if not line:
             continue
         out.append([f.strip('"').replace('""', '"') for f in line.split(",")])

 class TestReader(unittest.TestCase):
